about: The two-year cut's own lines (twin/video/cut5.py; rounds 5 and later): the opening and the replay. The other segments keep their lines in their own modules (figs5_intro, experiments, figs5_labs, floorspace_cut). One entry per line: id; seg, the segment it belongs to; at, seconds into it, or mark, a named moment of the replay (replay5.marks()), plus offset; text, a template: every {name} is filled from cut5.facts(), which reads the replayed run (data5.info()), so no number is typed in (cut5.check_own() fails on a digit or a number word outside a placeholder); when, a fact that must hold for the line to be spoken, so a line about what one round found is left out of a round in which it isn't so (cut5 plan lists the lines left out); src, where on screen its content is.

lines.text: This is a simulated benchmark, in round {round}: two alloy discovery campaigns, replayed for {years} in a digital twin of our planned automated lab, from the day the money arrives.
lines.src: cut5.title_frame: the title, 'Round 5 of a digital-twin benchmark', 'every result is simulated'

lines.text: Some of it comes from real sources: the lab's design and its 3-D model, footage from our own atomizer, the search spaces in the two proposals, and published prices. Everything else is simulated: every alloy, every measurement, and every result.
lines.src: compose.simulated_frame: the lab's 3-D model, then the two search spaces; the closing notes list what is real

lines.text: The replay starts on the day the money arrives. All of it is there, for both campaigns, and every station is ordered. There is no lab yet.
lines.src: replay5: the pill 'No lab yet: everything is ordered'; the build-out panel's first row; the spend plot's line 'two years' money, all at day 0'

lines.text: This is seed {seed} of {n_seeds}, with {policy} in the {stock} automated lab: the median seed for both campaigns together. It stays the same seed to the end.
lines.src: replay5.seed_badge, on screen for the whole replay (data5.info(): the round's median_seed for the replayed arm)

lines.text: Day {room_day}. The space is ready, and equipment comes in. A station is see-through until it is online, and until the cell is integrated, people run each of them.
lines.src: replay5: the pill 'The space is ready: N of 19 stations online, run by people'; the legend 'see-through: ordered, not online yet'

lines.text: Meanwhile the first alloys are made on the existing atomizer and printed at the partners: the panel on the left lists what runs outside the new lab. Under each plot, a line says why its curve is not moving yet.
lines.src: replay5.outside_panel; the strip under each best-so-far plot (data5.Replay5.flat)

lines.text: Day {cell_day}. The Shuttles and the mobile units are integrated. From here, the run's own bookings move the 3-D model: trays to the openings and units to the docks, round the clock.
lines.src: replay5: the pill 'The cell is integrated: robots run the lab'; the build-out panel; the moves panel

lines.text: Day {auto_al_T1}: aluminium's best new alloy passes the best existing alloy on this synthetic benchmark, and on day {auto_al_T2}, the halfway target. In the conventional lab, the same seed gets there on days {conv_al_T1} and {conv_al_T2}.
lines.src: replay5.target_tags: both aluminium tags, each with the conventional lab's same seed's day; the aluminium plot

lines.text: Day {auto_cu_T1}: copper's best new alloy passes both targets at once. In the conventional lab, this seed's copper reaches neither within {years}.
lines.src: replay5.target_tags: copper's tag ('passes both targets'; 'the conventional lab's seed: not within 730 days'); the copper plot

lines.text: Now both curves are flat, and each plot says why: the money is spent. With all of it there from the start, this lab has spent {pct_spent} percent of its {years} of money by day {d90}, and from here it mostly waits. The conventional lab is still spending.
lines.src: replay5.spend_panel: the mark '90 % spent by day N' on the automated lab's line, the conventional lab's dashed line still rising; the strips 'flat since day N. Why: the money is spent'

lines.text: In this seed, the automated lab's best new alloys end at {auto_al_best} for aluminium and {auto_cu_best} for copper, and the conventional lab's at {conv_al_best} and {conv_cu_best}. One seed is an example, not a result. The comparison over all {n_seeds} seeds comes next.
lines.src: replay5.best_panel: each curve's last value, both labs, both campaigns; the seed badge. Said as the clock runs to the end, every last value already on screen (no day number before the clock shows it)
